description: Create and switch to a new vault branch from the current tip. If the working copy has uncommitted changes, the branch is created but the session stays on the current branch (same as Parts Create, which does not discard unsaved edits); use git_branch_switch with confirm: true to switch while dirty. If create succeeds but switch fails, the result is still status created with switched: false and switchError set. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

name.description: New branch name. Created from the current tip; the session switches to it when the working copy is clean.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: git_branch_create
